Chapter 1: Signals

The idea of slack in systems (Marlow 2004) shapes everything that follows.
We will return to the cost of coordination in Chapter 3.
Queue behavior is covered in Chapter 2.

Bibliography

Marlow, J. Idle Capacity: Why Organizations Need Room. Northfield Press, 2004.
Ostrand, P. Notes on Feedback. Hale, 1999.
